corrections.text: The article states that at the 2031 rendezvous with 1998 KY26 "the spacecraft is expected to enter orbit and attempt to land on the surface, according to EarthSky." The cited EarthSky article does not support this detail; it says only that Hayabusa2 "should arrive at the asteroid in 2031." The Debrief, cited in the same sentence, likewise states only that the visit is "expected to occur in 2031" and contains no orbit-insertion or landing language. The 2031 rendezvous itself is correctly sourced; the orbit/landing specifics are not.
